wrong.question: Chen has a flower bed that is 165 meters long. Chen wants to fill her flower bed with plants. Chen's flowers grow 7 meters wide so she needs to leave 13.75 meters between every plant. Chen already owns 10 flowers. Each flowering plant costs ¥4 at the store, how much money will Chen spend at the store to fill up her flower bed?
wrong.model_response:
"""Chen has a flower bed that is 165 meters long. Chen wants to fill her flower bed with plants. Chen's flowers grow 7 meters wide so she needs to leave 13.75 meters between every plant. Chen already owns 10 flowers. Each flowering plant costs ¥4 at the store, how much money will Chen spend at the store to fill up her flower bed?"""
    flower_bed_length = 165
    flower_width = 7
    space_between = 13.75
    flowers_owned = 10
    cost_per_flower = 4
    
    # Space taken by each flower and the space after it
    space_per_flower = flower_width + space_between
    
    # Number of flowers that can fit in the flower bed
    flowers_needed = flower_bed_length / space_per_flower
    
    # Round down to get whole number of flowers
    flowers_needed = int(flowers_needed)
    
    # Number of additional flowers to buy
    flowers_to_buy = flowers_needed - flowers_owned
    
    # Total cost
    total_cost = flowers_to_buy * cost_per_flower
    result = total_cost
    return result
